benchmark_nvfp4_quant_performance: benchmark NVFP4 quantization performance across jit, flashinfer, aot_sgl_kernel, and torch_ref providers
test_probe_legacy_aot_quant: test whether the legacy AOT sgl_kernel scaled_fp4_quant operation is available and functional on the current GPU
test_probe_flashinfer_quant: test whether the flashinfer fp4_quantize function is available and functional on the current GPU
run_benchmark_cli: run the NVFP4 quant benchmark from the command line to measure and print performance across matrix shapes
summarize_torch_ref_quant: summarize the torch reference FP4 quantization that computes scale, clips, and rounds values to float4_e2m1fn levels
